items.label: direct-object particle

items.jp: ケーキを五つ作った

translation.pt-BR: Fiz cinco bolos.
translation.en: I made five cakes.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks what undergoes the action of making; here it is the cakes that were made (ケーキを = the cakes).

items.jp: スーパーで食料品を買う

translation.pt-BR: Comprar mantimentos no supermercado.
translation.en: Buying groceries at the supermarket.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: 'を' marks 食料品 as what receives the action of the verb 買う (what is bought).

items.jp: おかあさんに おかしを もらいました

translation.pt-BR: Ganhei doces da minha mãe.
translation.en: I got sweets from my mother.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates what was received (the sweets), the target of the action of receiving.

items.jp: わたしは まいあさ パンを 食べる

translation.pt-BR: Eu como pão toda manhã.
translation.en: I eat bread every morning.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates what is eaten (the bread), the direct target of the action of 食べる.

items.jp: 朝、顔を洗う

translation.pt-BR: De manhã, lavo o rosto.
translation.en: In the morning, I wash my face.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: Marks 顔 as the direct target of the action 洗う: it is the face that is being washed.

items.jp: 嘘をついて、父に叱られた

translation.pt-BR: Contei uma mentira e levei uma bronca do meu pai.
translation.en: I told a lie and got scolded by my father.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates 嘘 (lie) as that which one 'tells' with the verb つく.

items.jp: 弟にケーキを食べられた

translation.pt-BR: Meu irmão mais novo comeu meu bolo.
translation.en: My younger brother ate my cake.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates what was eaten (ケーキ = the cake), the direct target of the verb 食べる.
tokens: agent (the one who performed the action)

items.jp: 日本語を書いたり読んだりする

translation.pt-BR: Eu escrevo e leio em japonês, entre outras coisas.
translation.en: I do things like write and read in Japanese.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 日本語 as that on which the actions of writing and reading fall.
tokens: verb that closes the 〜たりする structure

items.jp: 電車を待っている間に本を読んだ

translation.pt-BR: Enquanto esperava o trem, li um livro.
translation.en: While I was waiting for the train, I read a book.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks 電車 as the object of 待つ (to wait for the train).
tokens: noun that forms あいだに

items.jp: 電車を待っている間に本を読んだ

translation.pt-BR: Enquanto esperava o trem, li um livro.
translation.en: While I was waiting for the train, I read a book.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks 本 as the object of 読む (to read a book).
tokens: noun that forms あいだに

items.jp: お茶を飲みませんか

translation.pt-BR: Você não quer tomar um chá?
translation.en: Would you like to have some tea?

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks お茶 as what will be drunk.

items.jp: 母がお茶をいれてくれた

translation.pt-BR: Minha mãe fez chá pra mim.
translation.en: My mom made tea for me.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks お茶 as what was prepared, the target of the action of いれる.

items.jp: 弟に本を読んでやった

translation.pt-BR: Li um livro para o meu irmão mais novo.
translation.en: I read a book to my younger brother.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates what was read, that is, the book, the direct target of the verb 読む.

items.jp: 薬を飲んだのにちっともよくならない

translation.pt-BR: Tomei o remédio, mas não melhorei nem um pouco.
translation.en: I took the medicine, but I didn't get any better.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks 薬 ('medicine') as that which was taken by the verb 飲む.
tokens: main verb of the subordinate clause
adverb (adverbial form of いい/よい)

items.jp: 妹はその映画をこわがっている

translation.pt-BR: Minha irmã mais nova está com medo daquele filme.
translation.en: My younger sister is scared of that movie.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks その映画 as the target of the fear. With こわがる, what causes the fear takes を.

items.jp: ガソリンスタンドでアルバイトをしている

translation.pt-BR: Trabalho meio período num posto de gasolina.
translation.en: I work part-time at a gas station.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks アルバイト as the target of the verb する ('to do what?' → to do the part-time job).

items.jp: はしの もち方を ならいました

translation.pt-BR: Aprendi a segurar os hashi (palitinhos).
translation.en: I learned how to hold chopsticks.

items.label: direct-object particle (を)

items.jp: 明日いっしょに映画を見よう

translation.pt-BR: Amanhã vamos ver um filme juntos.
translation.en: Tomorrow let's watch a movie together.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 映画 as the direct object of 見よう: it is the film that is going to be watched.
tokens: head of the manner adjunct (いっしょに)

items.jp: 洋風の朝ご飯を作った

translation.pt-BR: Fiz um café da manhã no estilo ocidental.
translation.en: I made a Western-style breakfast.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 洋風の朝ご飯 as what was prepared by the verb 作る.

items.jp: 首にネックレスを下げている

translation.pt-BR: Estou usando um colar no pescoço.
translation.en: I'm wearing a necklace around my neck.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks what is being worn/hung, that is, the necklace (ネックレス).

items.jp: デパートで洋服を見ました

translation.pt-BR: Vi umas roupas na loja de departamentos.
translation.en: I saw some clothes at the department store.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 洋服 as that which directly receives the action of the verb 見る (to see).

items.jp: ここにあなたの名前を書いてください

translation.pt-BR: Escreva seu nome aqui, por favor.
translation.en: Please write your name here.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 名前 (name) as that which will be written, the direct object of the verb 書く.

items.jp: 毎朝お茶を飲みます

translation.pt-BR: Tomo chá toda manhã.
translation.en: I drink tea every morning.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks お茶 (tea) as the object that is drunk. It is the standard particle for the target of a transitive verb like 飲む.

items.jp: ちちに とけいを もらいました

translation.pt-BR: Ganhei um relógio do meu pai.
translation.en: I got a watch from my father.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates what was received (the watch), that is, what the action of receiving falls upon.

items.jp: こちらにお名前をお書きください

translation.pt-BR: Por favor, escreva seu nome aqui.
translation.en: Please write your name here.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks お名前 as what will be written.

items.jp: 母とお茶を飲んだ

translation.pt-BR: Tomei chá com a minha mãe.
translation.en: I had tea with my mother.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks お茶 (tea) as the object that is drunk, the direct target of the verb 飲む.

items.jp: 子どもに野菜を食べてほしい

translation.pt-BR: Eu queria que meu filho comesse verdura.
translation.en: I wish my child would eat vegetables.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates what should be eaten: 野菜を食べる = 'to eat vegetables'. The object of the action remains marked by を within 〜てほしい.
tokens: target of the wish (who should eat)

items.jp: さむいから まどを しめてください

translation.pt-BR: Está frio, então fecha a janela, por favor.
translation.en: It's cold, so please close the window.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks まど (the window) as the target of the action of closing.

items.jp: ドアを開ける

translation.pt-BR: Abrir a porta.
translation.en: To open the door.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates the target of the action: ドアを = 'the door', that which is opened. The particle を is typical of transitive verbs like 開ける.

items.jp: 明日は会社を休む

translation.pt-BR: Amanhã vou faltar no trabalho.
translation.en: Tomorrow I'm going to miss work.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: Marks 会社 as the direct target of 休む. In Japanese 会社を休む ('to be absent from work') treats the company as the object of the verb of being absent/resting.

items.jp: まだ昼ご飯を食べていません

translation.pt-BR: Ainda não almocei.
translation.en: I haven't had lunch yet.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 昼ご飯 (lunch) as what is (or is not) eaten, the direct object of the verb 食べる.

items.jp: 校長が朝の話をしました

translation.pt-BR: O diretor deu o aviso da manhã.
translation.en: The principal gave the morning announcements.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 話 as the object of the verb する in the expression 話をする (to give an announcement/make a speech).

items.jp: 新しい産業が町を元気にしました

translation.pt-BR: A nova indústria deu vida nova à cidade.
translation.en: The new industry brought new life to the town.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 町 as the direct target of the action of 元気にする: the town is what was 'made lively'.

items.jp: 夏は毎日サンダルをはく

translation.pt-BR: No verão eu uso sandália todo dia.
translation.en: In the summer I wear sandals every day.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates サンダル (sandals) as that which one puts on with はく.

items.jp: 明日車を洗いたい

translation.pt-BR: Amanhã quero lavar o carro.
translation.en: I want to wash the car tomorrow.

items.label: direct object
items.explanation: を marks 車 (the car) as that which one wishes to wash; even with 〜たい, the object still takes を here.

items.jp: 父は料理をするのが下手です

translation.pt-BR: Meu pai cozinha mal.
translation.en: My father is bad at cooking.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を links 料理 ('food') to the verb する, forming 'to make food' (to cook). It is the object of the action.

items.jp: 薬を飲んで元気になった

translation.pt-BR: Tomei o remédio e melhorei.
translation.en: I took the medicine and got better.

items.label: direct object
items.explanation: を marks 薬 as the object of the verb 飲む ('to take medicine').

items.jp: プレゼントをどうも

translation.pt-BR: Valeu pelo presente.
translation.en: Thanks for the gift.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks プレゼント as the target the thanks refer to; here it points to the gift as that for which one says 'thanks'.

items.jp: 母はくだものを買いにいった

translation.pt-BR: Minha mãe foi comprar frutas.
translation.en: My mother went to buy fruit.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks くだもの ('fruit') as that which will be bought by the verb 買い.

items.jp: おばあさんにお茶を出した

translation.pt-BR: Servi chá para a vovó.
translation.en: I served tea to Grandma.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks お茶 (tea) as that which directly receives the action of the verb 出す.

items.jp: 新しい下着を買いました

translation.pt-BR: Comprei roupas íntimas novas.
translation.en: I bought new underwear.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks '新しい下着' (new underwear) as the object bought by the verb 買う.

items.jp: りんごをなんこ買いますか

translation.pt-BR: Quantas maçãs você vai comprar?
translation.en: How many apples are you going to buy?

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks りんご as what will be bought.
tokens: interrogative of quantity (part of なんこ)

items.jp: 引き出しから古い手紙を引き出す

translation.pt-BR: Tirar uma carta antiga da gaveta.
translation.en: To take an old letter out of the drawer.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 手紙 (letter) as that which is pulled out by the verb 引き出す.

items.jp: 前を真っすぐ行ってください

translation.pt-BR: Siga reto em frente, por favor.
translation.en: Please go straight ahead.

items.label: path/route particle
items.explanation: を here does not mark a direct object, but the path traversed with motion verbs (前を行く = to go/pass along the front, ahead).
tokens: adverb (modifies 行く), with intensifying prefix 真っ

items.jp: りんごを一つください

translation.pt-BR: Me dá uma maçã, por favor.
translation.en: One apple, please.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks 'the apple' as what one asks to be given; it is the object of the action of ください.

items.jp: 毎朝お茶を飲む

translation.pt-BR: Tomo chá toda manhã.
translation.en: I drink tea every morning.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks お茶 as what receives the action of the verb 飲む; it is what is being drunk.

items.jp: 鳥が空を翔る

translation.pt-BR: O pássaro voa pelo céu.
translation.en: The bird flies through the sky.

items.label: particle of space traversed
items.explanation: を with a verb of movement indicates the space traversed: the bird flies THROUGH the sky, not 'the sky' as an object.

items.jp: 本を読むことが好きです

translation.pt-BR: Eu gosto de ler livros.
translation.en: I like reading books.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 本 as the object of the verb 読む within the clause 'to read books': it is what is read.

items.jp: この紙にお名前を書いてください

translation.pt-BR: Por favor, escreva seu nome neste papel.
translation.en: Please write your name on this paper.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks お名前 (name) as what will be written, the direct object of 書く.

items.jp: 三に五を足すと八になる

translation.pt-BR: Três mais cinco dá oito.
translation.en: Three plus five makes eight.

items.label: direct object
items.explanation: を marks the five as what is added by the verb 足す.

items.jp: りんごを五つください

translation.pt-BR: Me dá cinco maçãs, por favor.
translation.en: Five apples, please.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks りんご (apple) as what one wants to receive, the direct object of the request with ください.

items.jp: 白い鳥が海の上を翔る

translation.pt-BR: Um pássaro branco voa por cima do mar.
translation.en: A white bird flies over the sea.

items.label: particle of space traversed
items.explanation: を with a verb of movement indicates that the bird flies THROUGH the space above the sea.

items.jp: ご飯を食べてから出かけます

translation.pt-BR: Depois de comer, vou sair.
translation.en: After eating, I'm going to go out.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks ご飯 as the object of the verb 食べる (that which is eaten).

items.jp: りんごを二つください

translation.pt-BR: Me dá duas maçãs, por favor.
translation.en: Two apples, please.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks りんご (apple) as the object of the request; the quantity 二つ appears after, without its own particle, before the verb.

items.jp: たまごを五つください

translation.pt-BR: Me dá cinco ovos, por favor.
translation.en: Give me five eggs, please.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks what receives the action of the request; here it is the eggs that one wants to receive (たまごを = the eggs).

items.jp: 母が料理をする間、私は本を読んでいた

translation.pt-BR: Enquanto minha mãe cozinhava, eu estava lendo um livro.
translation.en: While my mother was cooking, I was reading a book.

items.label: direct object
items.explanation: を marks 料理 as what is done: 料理をする ("to cook").

items.jp: 母が料理をする間、私は本を読んでいた

translation.pt-BR: Enquanto minha mãe cozinhava, eu estava lendo um livro.
translation.en: While my mother was cooking, I was reading a book.

items.label: direct object
items.explanation: を marks 本 as what is read: 本を読む ("to read a book").

items.jp: 母は自分で味噌を作る

translation.pt-BR: Minha mãe faz o próprio missô.
translation.en: My mother makes her own miso.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を points to 味噌 as what is made, the direct target of 作る.

items.jp: 気をつけてお帰りください

translation.pt-BR: Vá com cuidado na volta para casa.
translation.en: Take care on your way home.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks 気 as the object of つける in the fixed expression 気をつける ('to be careful').

items.jp: 字をきれいに書く

translation.pt-BR: Escrever as letras de forma bonita.
translation.en: To write the letters neatly.

items.label: marks 字 as the direct object of the verb 書く
items.explanation: を indicates what is written: the letters/characters are the direct target of the action of writing (書く).
tokens: な-adjective at the base of the adverb きれいに
auxiliary that turns きれい into an adverb

items.jp: 新聞社に手紙を送った

translation.pt-BR: Mandei uma carta para a empresa de jornal.
translation.en: I sent a letter to the newspaper company.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates that 手紙 (the letter) is what is sent, the direct target of the verb 送る.

items.jp: 市民の声を大切にしたい

translation.pt-BR: Quero valorizar a voz dos cidadãos.
translation.en: I want to value the voice of the citizens.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates that 市民の声 is that which one wants to 'value' (大切にする), functioning as the object of the action.
tokens: adverbial marker of 大切にする

items.jp: りんごを六つください

translation.pt-BR: Me vê seis maçãs, por favor.
translation.en: Six apples, please.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks りんご as what is requested/received.

items.jp: お名前を教えてください

translation.pt-BR: Me diz o seu nome, por favor.
translation.en: Please tell me your name.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks お名前 as the object of the verb 教える (that which one asks to be told).
tokens: object (noun with honorific prefix お, referring to the interlocutor's name)

items.jp: ごはんの前に手を洗う

translation.pt-BR: Lavo as mãos antes de comer.
translation.en: I wash my hands before eating.

items.label: direct object
items.explanation: を marks 手 (the hands) as that which is washed by the verb 洗う.

items.jp: 薬を飲んだらすぐに元気になった

translation.pt-BR: Tomei o remédio e logo melhorei.
translation.en: I took the medicine and got better right away.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 薬 ('medicine') as the direct object of 飲む ('to take'). It indicates what is taken.

items.jp: 音楽を小さくしてください

translation.pt-BR: Abaixe o volume da música, por favor.
translation.en: Please turn down the volume of the music.

items.label: direct object
items.explanation: を marks 音楽 as what will be altered ('the music/the volume'), the object of 小さくする.

items.jp: 今日は寒いので上着を着る

translation.pt-BR: Hoje está frio, então vou vestir um casaco.
translation.en: It's cold today, so I'm going to put on a coat.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 上着 as that which is put on by the verb 着る.

items.jp: りんごを四つください

translation.pt-BR: Me dá quatro maçãs, por favor.
translation.en: Four apples, please.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks りんご as the object of the request: it is the apple being requested with ください.

items.jp: 銀行でお金を引き出した

translation.pt-BR: Saquei dinheiro no banco.
translation.en: I withdrew money at the bank.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks お金 (money) as that which receives the action of the verb 引き出す.

items.jp: 野菜を食べるようにしてほしい

translation.pt-BR: Quero que você passe a comer verduras.
translation.en: I want you to start eating vegetables.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 野菜 ('vegetables') as the direct object of the verb 食べる ('to eat').
tokens: verb of the よう clause

items.jp: 今日は朝ご飯を食べないで来ました

translation.pt-BR: Hoje eu vim sem tomar café da manhã.
translation.en: Today I came without having breakfast.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 朝ご飯 as the direct object of the verb 食べる (what would be eaten).

items.jp: ボールペンを貸してください

translation.pt-BR: Me empresta uma caneta, por favor.
translation.en: Please lend me a pen.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks ボールペン as the object that receives the action of lending.

items.jp: 肉か さかなを 食べたいです

translation.pt-BR: Quero comer carne ou peixe.
translation.en: I want to eat meat or fish.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks the whole set 'meat or fish' as what one wants to eat.

items.jp: ご飯を食べてそれから出かけた

translation.pt-BR: Comi e depois disso saí.
translation.en: I ate and then went out.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks ご飯 as what is eaten, the direct target of the verb 食べる.

items.jp: その人を知っている

translation.pt-BR: Eu conheço essa pessoa.
translation.en: I know that person.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks その人 (that person) as the direct target of the action of knowing expressed by 知る.

items.jp: 今日は朝ごはんを食べなかった

translation.pt-BR: Hoje eu não tomei café da manhã.
translation.en: I didn't have breakfast today.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 朝ごはん as that which was (not) eaten, the direct target of the verb 食べる.

items.jp: 水をください

translation.pt-BR: Me dá água, por favor.
translation.en: Give me some water, please.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 水 as what is requested; it indicates the object that will receive the action of 'giving'.

items.jp: この道をまっすぐ行ってください

translation.pt-BR: Siga reto por essa rua, por favor.
translation.en: Please go straight down this street.

items.label: path particle (space traversed)
items.explanation: を here does not mark a direct object, but the path through which one passes; with movement verbs like 行く it indicates the route traveled ("along this street").

items.jp: 電車の中で音楽を聞く

translation.pt-BR: Ouço música no trem.
translation.en: I listen to music on the train.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 音楽 (music) as that which directly receives the action of the verb 聞く (to listen).

items.jp: 社長はこの本をお読みになりますか

translation.pt-BR: O senhor vai ler este livro?
